entities.summary: Vladimir Semyonovich Kemenov was a Soviet art historian and statesman who was Director of the State Tretyakov Gallery, headed the VOKS for the USSR in the 1940s, was Deputy Minister of Culture in 1954-1956 and vice-president of the Academy of Arts in 1966-1988.
